# Test Assembly

Here we will rely on [UMI Barcoded Illumina MiSeq 2x250 BCR mRNA](https://presto.readthedocs.io/en/stable/workflows/Stern2014_Workflow.html)

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
FilterSeq.py quality -s SRR1383456_1.fastq -q 20 --outname MS12_R1 --log FS1.log
FilterSeq.py quality -s SRR1383456_2.fastq -q 20 --outname MS12_R2 --log FS2.log

MaskPrimers.py score -s MS12_R1_quality-pass.fastq -p Stern2014_CPrimers.fasta \
    --start 15 --mode cut --barcode --outname MS12_R1 --log MP1.log
    
MaskPrimers.py score -s MS12_R2_quality-pass.fastq -p Stern2014_VPrimers.fasta \
    --start 0 --mode mask --outname MS12_R2 --log MP2.log
    
PairSeq.py -1 MS12_R1_primers-pass.fastq -2 MS12_R2_primers-pass.fastq \
    --1f BARCODE --coord sra
    
BuildConsensus.py -s MS12_R1_primers-pass_pair-pass.fastq --bf BARCODE --pf PRIMER \
    --prcons 0.6 --maxerror 0.1 --maxgap 0.5 --outname MS12_R1 --log BC1.log
    
BuildConsensus.py -s MS12_R2_primers-pass_pair-pass.fastq --bf BARCODE --pf PRIMER \
    --maxerror 0.1 --maxgap 0.5 --outname MS12_R2 --log BC2.log
    
PairSeq.py -1 MS12_R1_consensus-pass.fastq -2 MS12_R2_consensus-pass.fastq \
    --coord presto
    
AssemblePairs.py align -1 MS12_R2_consensus-pass_pair-pass.fastq \
    -2 MS12_R1_consensus-pass_pair-pass.fastq --coord presto --rc tail \
    --1f CONSCOUNT --2f CONSCOUNT PRCONS --outname MS12 --log AP.log
    
ParseHeaders.py collapse -s MS12_assemble-pass.fastq -f CONSCOUNT --act min

CollapseSeq.py -s MS12*reheader.fastq -n 20 --inner --uf PRCONS \
    --cf CONSCOUNT --act sum --outname MS12
    
SplitSeq.py group -s MS12_collapse-unique.fastq -f CONSCOUNT --num 2 --outname MS12

ParseHeaders.py table -s MS12_atleast-2.fastq -f ID PRCONS CONSCOUNT DUPCOUNT

ParseLog.py -l FS1.log FS2.log -f ID QUALITY
ParseLog.py -l MP1.log MP2.log -f ID PRIMER BARCODE ERROR
ParseLog.py -l BC1.log BC2.log -f BARCODE SEQCOUNT CONSCOUNT PRIMER PRCONS PRCOUNT \
    PRFREQ ERROR
ParseLog.py -l AP.log -f ID LENGTH OVERLAP ERROR PVALUE FIELDS1 FIELDS2
```

# Build VHH Antibody reads

Note: [rprimer](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/rprimer/inst/doc/getting-started-with-rprimer.html) may have helpful tools.

#### Imports

```{r}
# For sequence logos
library(ggseqlogo)
library(ShortRead)
```

#### Utility Function `search_seqs`

```{r}
# search_seqs
# accepts reads (from fastq file)
# and motif dataframe
search_seqs <- function(reads, motifs, top_50 = FALSE){
  if (top_50){
      ## ###
      ## tables() takes only top-50 reads
      ## ###
      
      # Tabulate top reads
      tbls <- tables(reads)
      # Pull top reads
      reads <- names(tbls$top[1:length(tbls$top)])
  } else {
      reads <- as.data.frame(sread(reads))$x
  }
  for (motif in motifs$seq){
    hits <- sum(grepl(motif, reads)*1)
    if (hits != 0){
          cat('\t',motifs[motifs$seq == motif,]$motif, '\n')
          cat('\t Sequence:', motif, '\n')
          cat("\t\tHits: ", hits,'/',length(reads),'\t', 
              paste(round(hits/length(reads)*100, 2), '%', sep = ''),
              '\n', sep = '')
    }
  }
}
```


#### Motifs to Search For

`5' -> 3'`

```{r}
## Motif IDs (from Primer Info slides)
# All 
vhh_rep_motif_ids <- c("idx_two_read_primer",
                       "read_one_primer",
                       "vhh_forward",
                       "vector_vhh_forward")

vhh_rep_motif_seqs <- c("AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCTACAC",
                        "TCGTCGGCAGCGTCAGATGTGTATAAGAGACAG",
                        "GGTGGTCCTGGCTGC",
                        "CCCAACCGGCCATGGC")

vhh_rep <- as.data.frame(cbind(vhh_rep_motif_ids, vhh_rep_motif_seqs))

colnames(vhh_rep) <- c("motif", "seq")

## VHH Hinge

vhh_hinge_motif_ids <- c("illumina_binding",
                         "mplex_read_two_primer",
                         "mplex_idx_read_seq_primer",
                         "short_hinge",
                         "long_hinge")

vhh_hinge_motif_seqs <- c("CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGATGT",
                          "GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATC",
                          intToUtf8(rev(utf8ToInt("GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATC"))),
                          "CTTCGCTGTGGTGCGC",
                          "GGTTTTGGTGTCTTGGG")

vhh_hinge <- as.data.frame(cbind(vhh_hinge_motif_ids, vhh_hinge_motif_seqs))
colnames(vhh_hinge) <- c("motif", "seq")

vhh_seqs <- rbind(vhh_rep, vhh_hinge)


## ###
## 


## ###
## Reverse complement search
## ###

vhh_rev_comp_seqs <- vhh_seqs

for (i in 1:nrow(vhh_seqs)){
  vhh_rev_comp_seqs$seq[i] <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(vhh_seqs$seq[i])))
}

vhh_rev_comp_seqs$motif <- paste("rev_comp_", vhh_rev_comp_seqs$motif, sep = '')


## Rbind results
vhh_seqs <- rbind(vhh_seqs, vhh_rev_comp_seqs)

## ###
## 3' -> 5'(reverse)
## ###

reverse_vhh_seqs <- vhh_seqs

for (i in 1:nrow(vhh_seqs)){
  reverse_vhh_seqs$seq[i] <- intToUtf8(rev(utf8ToInt(vhh_seqs$seq[i])))
}

reverse_vhh_seqs$motif <- paste("reversed_", reverse_vhh_seqs$motif, sep = '')
# Rbind results
vhh_seqs <- rbind(vhh_seqs, reverse_vhh_seqs)
# Remove (reversed) duplicates
vhh_seqs <- vhh_seqs[!duplicated(vhh_seqs$seq),]




# Cleanup
rm(list = ls()[grepl("vhh_hinge_|vhh_rep_", ls())])
rm(vhh_hinge, vhh_rep, vhh_rev_comp_seqs, reverse_vhh_seqs)
```

## Load Assembly Data

```{r}
# load proc file addresses
procs <- list.files(root_dir)[grepl("Proc", list.files(root_dir))][1:4]
procs <- paste(procs, '/', sep = '')

# Quick index-- we have 4 different read sets (3 originals, one a double-check from me)
proc_index <- 1

# Define the folder with fastq files in it
fastq_dir <- paste(root_dir, procs[proc_index], sep = '')

# Reference Logs
logs <- readLines(paste(fastq_dir, list.files(fastq_dir)[grepl("txt", list.files(fastq_dir))], sep = ''))[1]

# Subset fastqs
fastqs <- list.files(fastq_dir)[grepl("fastq", list.files(fastq_dir))]

# assembly file
assembly <- fastqs[grepl("assemble-pass", fastqs)]

# Load the assemble pass
tmp <- ShortRead::readFastq(paste(root_dir,procs[proc_index],assembly,sep = ''))
tmp <- as.data.frame(sread(tmp))

# Store the experiment name
colnames(tmp) <- assembly
```
